patch.value: Compile sparse Azure refresh plans with explicit field accounting

Overlap rechecked: sync.ts owns transport batching and three-way field reconciliation; core list output budgets shape local output; pm-jira search projections and pm-linear GraphQL selection own different provider protocols. This adds a read-only, reviewable, costed refresh compiler using saved Azure revisions/bases and declared pm field needs.

A 1000-item fixture uses at most five batch reads per refresh phase; unchanged items cause zero pm mutations; every requested field is accounted for; unavailable rows never become deletions. Typed SDK and CLI, compact output, typed remedies, no-git real tracker validation, seeded property and boundary tests, unchanged release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented read-only compileRefreshPlan and observeRefreshPlan plus ado refresh-plan. Uses certified listAllComplete reads, existing Azure batchIds and AdoClient transport, and the existing field map/base reader. Fresh revision probes distinguish exact matches from unavailable rows. Artifacts contain read requests only, no journal, idempotency keys, apply path, status-name inference or shared mutable state. Foreign/unlinked records are skipped with counted reasons. Testing strict schema boundaries, 1000-item costs, SDK readback and real non-git trackers next.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Model-based acceptance passed: 500 seeded import/export/sync sequences with SDK-read reference state, CRLF/whitespace variants, all mapped native fields, custom active/blocked/done/canceled/draft statuses, hierarchy and related edges, exact replays and older-input refusals. Found and fixed older-revision rollback in existing sync. Terminal transitions now use SDK registry roles. Additional 500 seeded refresh sequences cover accounting/omissions/extreme revisions. Six competing transitions at every async observation boundary preserve peer writes. Read-only public main tracker copy: 32 items, 69 authoritative files hash-identical; unchanged projection 1 probe/0 hydration, all-changed 1/1 and 288 cells; mixed 17 unchanged, 8 changed, 7 unavailable, 72 cells; complete JSON 1095/1419/1351 bytes. Synthetic Azure evidence only; no live Azure credential validation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review continuation: closing SDK-acquisition class. Host context supplies PmClient schema queries, so import/export/sync will use ctx.sdk.client only and query roles lazily when a status changes. The pinned context does not expose low-level history/lease primitives needed by resolution; standalone service callers will inject their SDK explicitly, while resolution commands use only the documented pm-install host SDK link with a canonical module anchor and typed refusal. Delete argv-based loader fallback. Add packed install-shape acceptance in isolated temporary prefixes, retaining all previous sparse-compiler evidence.
